adversarial_audit.objection: The unequal-source cube is exactly translation covariant.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Rejected: a finite W6 control has orientation ranks from 0 to 2025, so bit translation cannot be unitary covariance.

adversarial_audit.objection: A concentration bound for one orientation cannot cover 2^k masks.
adversarial_audit.resolution: The relative variance decays as m_n^(2-k), which beats the 2^k union by a factor 2^-Theta(n(log n)^2).

adversarial_audit.objection: Conditioning all sources distinct destroys independence and invalidates the theorem.
adversarial_audit.resolution: The conditional bad-event probability is at most the independent bad-event probability divided by P_cf; asymptotically P_cf=1-o(1). The n=12 finite bound is correctly left vacuous because its collision-free mass is extremely small.

adversarial_audit.objection: Nearly equal orientation ranks imply a graded endpoint gap.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Equal-dimensional subspaces can have arbitrarily different overlap kernels and shorted boundary effects.

claim_gate.reason: Every orientation rank is simultaneously typical at natural depth, but the matrix-valued pair-core geometry is uncontrolled.

falsifiers_triggered: Unequal-source orientation projectors are not exactly translation covariant at finite n.
Sellke support covering is not needed for rank concentration; the exact second moment is much stronger at natural block size.
Rank concentration cannot substitute for matrix endpoint-kernel concentration.

proof_obligations.resolution: Character column orthogonality gives the exact conjugacy-class formula, checked by direct tuple enumeration at S3.
The class-size variance exponent beats the 2^k orientation count and all p(n) targets at natural k.
Divide the independent-source failure bound by the exact collision-free mass, which tends to one asymptotically.
Requires matrix concentration or representation-level control of pair-core overlap kernels, not scalar multiplicities alone.

summary: Proved exact Plancherel multiplicity second moments and uniform rank concentration over all natural-depth orientations and targets, including after global-distinctness conditioning.

theorem_contract.asymptotic_rate: At k=Theta(n log n), p(n)=exp(O(sqrt n)) and m_n=Theta(n^2), so the simultaneous failure is 2^-Theta(n(log n)^2).
theorem_contract.collision_free_transfer: Conditioning all 2k sources distinct divides by P_cf(n,k)=1-o(1).
theorem_contract.exact_second_moment: E[X_nu^2]=|S_n|^-2 sum_K chi_nu(K)^2 |K|^(2-C), from Plancherel weighting and character column orthogonality.
theorem_contract.physical_rank_identity: rank(U_e)/D_all equals the normalized multiplicity of the target in the k source irreps selected by e.
theorem_contract.scope: This proves rank concentration only. It does not identify or compare the physical endpoint-kernel operators.
theorem_contract.uniform_union_bound: Chebyshev plus a union over 2^k orientations and p(n) targets gives 2^k p(n)(p(n)-1)m_n^(2-k)/epsilon^2.
